human hematopoietic progenitor cells differentiate into mast cells within a collagen matrix, and that the use of a serum-supplemented stem cell medium supports the growth of fibroblasts and ECs in addition to mast cells in this 3D system.

developing a tissue-engineered system to study MCs in a 3D microenvironment with ancillary cells.
the development of human mast cell (MC) models.
the development of human MCs from HSCs and the development of a tissue-engineered 3D collagen model with fibroblasts and ECs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a 3D culture model of HSCs within collagen matrix with StemSpan media supplemented with serum supports the development of functional human MCs.
the 3D tissue model with stem cell medium supports the development of MCs, fiboblasts, and ECs, and is an important step in the development of a more relevant model of tissue-resident MCs.

the development of functional human mast cells (MCs), fibroblasts and vascular endothelial cells from hematopoietiic stem cells within a 3-dimensional collagen matrix is dependent upon the use of stem cell media supplemented with serum.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MCs can develop from HSCs in a 3D system and that StemSpan media supplemented with serum at the last week is optimal for supporting MC development.
the 3D matrix with StemSpan supplemented with serum at the last week of culture supports the development of functional human mast cells.
a 3D model with HSCs, fibroblast and endothelial cells in StemSpan with 10% FBS added for the last week of culture can be used to study the development of functional mast cells within the 3D matrix.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the stem cell medium StemSpan with serum at the last week supports the development of functional HSCs-derived MCs within a collagen scaffold.
a stem cell media supplemented with 5% serum is sufficient for supporting the development of functional human MCs from HSCs in a 3D system.
a 3D model with fibroblasts and ECs can be used to generate functional MCs and the stem cell media supports the survival of the ancillary cells.
